answer: One concrete mechanism: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because beacon only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, mirror is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any cedar approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
